name: Uma Tsuyoi
source:
Uma is a rival in Heartbreaker: The Visual Novel, and the antagonist of Episode 2.
She will grow close to Kouhai by working out with her, helping Kouhai build back confidence after her experiences with Sagishi in Episode 1.
